description: This Java source file defines the PredefinedShelf class, which represents a predefined, non-deletable shelf within a book-tracking application. The class extends Shelf, includes JPA annotations for persistence, and defines enumerations and methods specific to predefined shelves like 'To read', 'Reading', 'Read', and 'Did not finish'.

classes.description: A class representing a predefined, non-removable shelf, with an enumerated name, associated books, and ORM/JPA annotations for persistence.
